Lemma
1. ch7:7.15

The Ricci tensor is symmetric, and \[ R_{ij}=R_{kij}^{\, k}=R^k{}_{ikj} =-R^k{}_{kij}=-R_{ikj}^{\, k}. \]
Proof

\sketch Contract the first and fourth indices in the skew symmetries and pair symmetry of the Riemann tensor. The first Bianchi identity then identifies the two possible contractions and gives symmetry in the remaining indices.

□

Define the traceless Ricci tensor by \[ \stackrel{\circ }{\mathrm{Rc}} =\mathrm{Rc}-\frac1nSg. \]
